scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Feature-subspace ensemble: 5 LGBM members each trained on a different deterministic 50% random subspace of the 237-feature static full view; equal-logit blend as candidate.

protocol.members: 5 LGBM xt_xt_f10 (seed 1) members; subspace seeds 11,22,33,44,55 each selecting 118 of 237 static features (numpy default_rng(seed) choice, no replacement).
protocol.training: each member trained on outer-FIT only with inner 10% ES (seed 1, identical split across members); predicts fold-0.
protocol.candidate: equal-logit blend of the 5 member fold-0 predictions.
protocol.evaluation: fold-0 AUC of blend; port_delta vs route_ref; Spearman vs route_ref; per-member AUCs reported.
protocol.single_member_contrast: mean member AUC vs blend AUC quantifies the subspace-ensemble gain mechanism.
